provenance: installed Ubuntu distribution packages, dpkg-owned and md5-verified via the same verified_system_file gate as the qualified source-CI lane; no pip, no downloads during build or guest execution

guest_image.base: same signed Alpine ISO as vm/image-lock.json

notes: The lock pins the exact distribution package versions; every runtime file is re-verified against the dpkg checksum database at build time and against the recorded SHA-256 manifest inside the guest before any source test executes.
